අƯ ɪෙශෂThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
EXTRAORDINARY
(Published by Authority)
PART I: SECTION (I) – GENERAL
Government Notiﬁcations
ANIMAL DISEASES ACT, NO. 59 OF 1992
Order Under Section 5 and Consequential Arrangements

AFRICAN Swine Fever (ASF) is a speciﬁed and highly contagious disease as deﬁned in the First Schedule of the Animal Diseases Act, No. 59 of 1992, and the Orders made thereunder. It is a disease that may occur in any Divisional Secretary’s Division in Sri Lanka.

I, Kasthuri Arachchige Chandrika Hemali Abeyrathna Kothalawala, Director General of Animal Production and Health, by virtue of the powers vested in me under the above Act, do hereby declare by this Order that:

1. All Divisional Secretary’s Divisions in Sri Lanka are hereby declared as infected or susceptible areas for African Swine Fever (ASF) for the purposes and within the meaning of the Animal Diseases Act.
1. The pig (Sus scrofa) is the susceptible species for this disease; and

2. This Order shall come into force on the date of its publication in the Gazette and, unless earlier revoked or further extended under Section 5(3) of the Act, shall remain in effect for a period of three months from the date of such publication.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
I ෙකʣටස: (I) ෙඡදය – ɼ ලංකා ȝජාතාǦƵක සමාජවාǏ ජනරජෙɏ අƯ ɪෙශෂ ගැසŸ පƴය – 2025.06.13
PART I: SEC. (I) – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 13.06.2025 2A

2. While this Order remains in force, I, the Director General of Animal Production and Health, hereby prohibit the following activities within or in relation to the infected or susceptible areas in order to prevent the spread, control, and containment of African Swine Fever (ASF):

I. Under Section 5(4) of the Animal Diseases Act, the removal, transportation, driving, or movement of pigs, pork, pork products, or risk material within, to, or from the infected or susceptible area without a permit issued by the Divisional Government Veterinary Surgeon of the respective Division, as per Form VII of the regulations published in Gazette No. 1108/23 dated December 03, 1999.
II. The slaughter of susceptible animals (pigs) for meat purposes.
III. Holding or conducting live animal markets involving susceptible animals.

IV. Sale, display for sale, offering for sale, storage, supply, distribution, or further processing of pigs, pork, pork products, or infected materials without a permit issued by an Authorized Ofﬁcer nominated in this Order.

V. Without complying with the guidelines issued by the Department of Animal Production and Health, dispose of any carcass, part thereof, or contaminated material by placing it in any water body or leaving it in any location in a manner that may allow other animals to access, consume, or transport such materials to other places.
VI. Slaughtering, storing, or processing in any slaughterhouse, storage facility, or meat processing center that is not approved by an Authorized Ofﬁcer nominated in this Order.
3. Animals in non-infected breeder, fattener, or commercial farms may be bred, sold, slaughtered, or processed, subject to the following conditions:
I. The breeder farms must be registered with the Animal Breeding Division of the Department of Animal Production and Health, Peradeniya.
II. Animals intended for slaughter, fattening, or breeding must be conﬁrmed negative for African Swine Fever (ASF) by an authorized ofﬁcer in writing.
III. A copy of the health certiﬁcate and the test report of purchased, transported, or slaughtered animals must be retained at the respective farm or slaughterhouse.
4. Admitting animals to affected farms

I. Before restocking, the farm must obtain a certiﬁcate from the range Veterinary Surgeon certifying that the premises have been properly disinfected and are in compliance with the prescribed biosecurity measures.

5. By virtue of, and in the exercise of, the powers vested in me under the provisions of the Animal Diseases Act, I hereby nominate the following ofﬁcers as Authorized Ofﬁcers for the purposes of Section 3(3) of the Act, to take action to prevent the commission of prohibited activities set out in Paragraph 02(1) of this Order, and to exercise the powers of an Authorized Ofﬁcer under Sections 13 and 14 of the Animal Diseases Act for that purpose:
1. Director-Animal Health, Department of Animal Production and Health
2. Director-Wildlife Health, Department of Wildlife and Conservation
3. Chief Municipal Veterinary Surgeon-Municipal Councils
4. The Provincial Directors of Animal Production and Health of each Province
